_doc: Orc and Vampyr stage-1 blockouts rendered by the sprite pipeline (CC0 MPFB bodies; plate as shells conformed to the body plus Blender primitives, kit_extras.py), reduced to core + heartland with the outline on the silhouette only, speckle merged and the tokens hand-edited (token_edits.json). Cast fix after the slop audit of 2026-10-15. Round 3 (2026-10-16): bodies, tokens and normal strips hand-repainted part by part in palette ramps (tools/look/cast_r3/); heads kept from the render. Round 4 (2026-10-16, tools/look/cast_r4/): the orc repainted inside the round-2 alpha (bulk back), skin on the green-grey skin_orc ramp, tusks in bone 3 (director: 'bulk and green-grey skin'); the Vampyr in his own armour (slim spaulders, no fauld box) with a fanned cape; tokens are the SE frames at half scale.
status: prototype sprites for the golden references; cast fix awaiting the director's look approval
